title: Derivation of Stacked Two-Block Slipping Threshold
assumptions: Top block m1 rests on bottom block m2
starting_principles: Newton's second law for top block isolated

ordered_steps.explanation: Analyze top block m1: only horizontal force is static friction f_s from m2.
ordered_steps.equation_latex: f_s = m_1 a, \quad N_1 = m_1 g \implies f_{s,\text{max}} = \mu_s m_1 g

ordered_steps.explanation: Determine maximum acceleration of top block without slipping.
Apply second law to combined system of mass (m1 + m2) moving with acceleration a_max.

limiting_cases: If F <= F_thresh, a = F/(m1 + m2); if F > F_thresh, a1 = mu_k g and a2 = (F - mu_k m1 g)/m2
